decisions.requirement: Individual spell skills, source openings, source raw caps and source parent branching thresholds

decisions.requirement: Stock practice can reach the highest normal grade

decisions.requirement: Actual historical POWER words; command casting and genuine speech-triggered casting; language-aware echo
decisions.limit: Both enter the same guarded pipeline; generated output never triggers a second cast

decisions.requirement: Quiet costs more and is harder; volume/method difficulty configurable; area defined per spell from source
decisions.limit: No universal ally immunity or caster exclusion; visible effects and magical detection remain

decisions.requirement: Stock charm can affect PCs; each spell can disable PC targets; IC command whitelist for PCs and NPCs
decisions.limit: Reject account/settings/OOC/builder commands and all alias/indirect dispatch bypasses

decisions.limit: No heavy temporary-NPC database accumulation; handle early death, remains, possessions, references and restart

decisions.limit: Historical unrestricted activation does not override this explicit stock choice

decisions.requirement: Recharging caster must legitimately reproduce stored power
decisions.limit: Capacities, timings, prices and failure rates remain tunable proposals

native_acceptance.name: Summon early death

native_acceptance.required_result: No resurrection/second death; foreign item conserved; temporary heavy graph eventually retired when references clear

native_acceptance.name: Lifecycle modes

native_acceptance.required_result: Correct persistence/death/remains behaviour and exactly one terminal transition; permanent creation survives its no-expiry contract

native_acceptance.name: High-volume retirement

native_acceptance.required_result: Stable eligible heavy-row/timer/subscription counts after cleanup; every retained record explained

native_acceptance.name: Effigy and shadow

native_acceptance.required_result: Correct instance identity, anchor and focus; canonical skills/resources not duplicated; owner survives temporary collapse as configured

native_acceptance.name: Ward and bane
native_acceptance.scenario: Use Severing Refuge against allowed/blocked element interactions; Apex Bane against eligible/ineligible beings
native_acceptance.required_result: Functional bounded ward and resisted category attack, not cosmetic effects or name checks

native_acceptance.name: Pocket conservation
native_acceptance.scenario: Fill Folded Pocket, attempt pocket nesting/body entry, transfer and collapse after restart
native_acceptance.required_result: Capacity enforced, nesting/living targets rejected, all foreign contents released exactly once

native_acceptance.name: Permanent tier exception
native_acceptance.scenario: Exercise timed Flame Knife tier and configured highest-tier permanent output with real component
native_acceptance.required_result: Correct source-informed per-tier output; timed gear cannot yield permanent salvage; permanent output properly paid

native_acceptance.name: Item activation
native_acceptance.scenario: Caster and non-caster use stock charged wand; builder changes one test item to anyone; try depleted charge then explicit focus
native_acceptance.required_result: Stock caster gate, configurable exception, preserved captured potency; no free fallback or acquired/mastery gains

native_acceptance.name: Recharge
native_acceptance.scenario: Qualified producer, wrong magic type, unacquired spell, insufficient grade and insufficient reproducible potency
native_acceptance.required_result: Only legitimate producer succeeds; bounded charge/payment commit, no mixed payload or duplicate charge after restart

native_acceptance.name: Rerun safety

native_acceptance.required_result: Preserve edits/clones/players, report conflicts, honour retirement, repair only owned partial work and preserve stable IDs

native_acceptance.name: Cross-feature uncertain failure
native_acceptance.scenario: Inject provider failure after debit/effect/progression or lifecycle transition; retry via another body/route and restart
native_acceptance.required_result: Conservative quarantine/reconciliation, no replay/refund/double grade/second corpse; unrelated records remain usable
